contributions.detail: EMPTY SCHEDULE, honestly zero. p2's grid is entirely blank except a hand-drawn SLASHED ZERO in the FIRST data row's Amount cell - that row has no date, no donor, no address and no In-Kind mark, so it is a nil mark, not a transaction (zero-glyph ruling: the glyph denotes 0, and a nil mark is not a row). The printed TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS cell carries the same slashed zero. The cover's line-1 THIS REPORT cell also carries a hand-drawn slashed zero, so the zero rows equal the THIS figure; they do NOT equal the CUMULATIVE 640.20 carried in from the earlier filing, hence scope=period. This is the filer's FINAL report of the 2024 cycle (period 10-21-24 to 1-6-25). This cover generation has no $50-or-less line, so cover_le50_* are null (field absent), not zero.

expenditures.detail: EMPTY SCHEDULE, honestly zero. p3's grid is completely blank - even the first row's Amount cell is empty - and only the printed TOTAL EXPENDITURES cell carries the hand-drawn slashed zero. The prior filing in this cycle is not in my chunk, so the cross-filing chain could not be run; the cover's own 'Total LAST Report' column (640.20 / 640.20) is internally consistent with a prior filing that had raised and spent 640.20.
